name: Sikafloor Level PRO
paste:
SIKAFLOOR® LEVEL PRO: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor® Level PRO, March 2025, Version 02.07 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/sikafloor_level_pro.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor® Level PRO where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 02.07).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor® Level Pro is a premium levelling compound applied prior to the installation of flooring.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Applied in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor®, SikaBond®, Sikadur®, SikaTite® & Davco® ranges.
    - • Recommended underlayment for all commercial & residential floorcoverings
    - • Levelling of uneven concrete
    - • Suitable for new or old internal concrete substrates
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor® Level PRO
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: HIGH FLOWING SELF-LEVELLING & SMOOTHING COMPOUND
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Green Star (VOC-SCQMD Rule 1168)
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very low VOC (3 grams per litre)
    - Green Star Certified
    - Very low shrinkage
    - Simply mix & apply - No slaking or re-mixing required
    - Able to be applied across large floor areas in a single application
    - Non-combustible
    - Good pot life and working time
    - Pump or manual application
    - Highly fluid
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polymer modified cement compound
    - Appearance and colour: Grey powder
    - Density: 1.24kg's/m³
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compressive strength: 1 day cure > 10MPa; 28 day cure > 25MPa
    - Flexural-strength: 28 day cure > 4.5MPa
    - Reaction to fire: No hazardous combustion products are known
    - Water absorption: Porous
2.6 System structure.
    | Porous Concrete | Moisture Barrier | Non-porous Surfaces |
    | Sikafloor® Level Pro | Sikafloor®-158 W Fast | Sikafloor®-14 Eco Prep |
    | Primer | Barrier | 'N' Prime |
    | Sikafloor® Level Pro | Sikafloor®-14 Eco Prep | Sikafloor® Level Pro |
    | 'N' Prime |
    | Subsequent suitable | Sikafloor® Level Pro | Subsequent suitable |
    | materials | materials |
    | Subsequent suitable materials |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20kg Bag - 48 bags per pallet
    - Shelf life: Unopened bags can be stored for up to 9 months in a cool, dry and weather proof environment.
    - Storage conditions: Bags must be stored off the floor. Avoid sitting bags in direct sunlight prior to application.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 02.07) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - Concrete floors should be fully cured, structurally sound, clean, dry, and free of surface contaminates and dust for Eg. Concrete must be porous and accept water penetration.
    - Test by lightly sprinkling water on various areas of the substrate. If water penetrates, then a good bond with a selected primer can be achieved. If water beads and fails to be absorbed by the concrete surface contaminants are present then loss of adhesion may occur. Contaminates that are present should be mechanically removed beforein-stallation.
    - Concrete must be free of efflorescence and not subject to hydrostatic pressure.
    - If the concrete substrate has efflorescence or high moisture (RH) and moisture sensitive flooring is being installed Sikafloor® Moisture Barrier System may be considered (Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier
    - + Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime + Sikafloor® Level Pro). Contact your local Sika® office for further information. PRIMING;
    - Internal Porous Priming
    - • Sikafloor® Level Pro Primer - undiluted (Neat)
    - Note: Correct amount of priming liquid should always be applied to the prepared substrate giving good penetration and film build. Thin applications may result in pinholing or debonding levelling compound from the substrate.
    - Do Not Allow primer to pool while drying. On particularly porous (mechanically prepared) surfaces or where the initial prime coat absorbs immediately a second coat is recommended. Average dry time ~20–30 min (per coat)
3.3 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Internal Non-Porous Priming.
    - • Sikafloor®-14 Prep 'N' Prime - undiluted (Neat)
    - Note: When applying primer to Non-porous surface use a paint roller and apply one thin even coat.
    - Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Must Be Completely Dry (50 min+) prior to applying Sikafloor® products.
    - The selected primer should completely dry prior to the application of Sikafloor® Levelling Systems.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 02.07) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 5 - 5.2 Litres of clean, cool water
    - Yield: 12 Litres - 4m² @ 3mm thickness
    - Layer thickness: 1 - 30mm(neat) and 10-50mm (bulked out with 1-2mm aggregate) .
    - Pot Life: 18 minutes @ 23°C
    - Initial set time: 55-95 Minutes @ 23°C
    - Final set time: 60-100 Min @ 23°C
4.3 Waiting time to overcoating. Allow 18 hours at 23°C prior to the application of impervious floor coverings. Drying is dependent on thickness of application, temperature, air flow & relative humidity. Increased air flow will help with drying speeds in cooler temperatures.
4.4 Equipment.
    - ▪ High speed heavy duty electric drill, mixing paddle & suitable size bucket/vessel - 20L +
    - ▪ Purpose built mechanical pump
4.5 Mixing.
    - Mix the entire 20kg bag of powder with 5 - 5.2 Litres of clean, cool water. When applying above 20mm Sika® recommends 5L be added.
    - Slowly add powder to the water while mixing with a suitable electric drill and mixing paddle.
    - Thoroughly mix for a minimum 2 minutes to a lumpfree consistency.
    - Not mixing for the minimum recommended time or additional water may result in product irregularities and possible product failure.Sikafloor® Level Pro can be bulked out with 10kg of 1-2mm aggregate for thicknesses 10-50mm thick.
4.6 Application. Pour or Pump Sikafloor® Level Pro, then spread with a long handled gauged spreader to heights as required. Sikafloor® Level Pro will seek its own level during the first 12 minutes. For touch-ups, use a flat steel trowel.
4.7 Application - Note.
    - Areas of application must have fresh airflow to assist with product hydration and drying.
    - Closed off rooms with no fresh air will retard the drying process and possibly lead to product failure.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water before the material sets.
4.9 Limitations and important considerations - Limitations.
    - ▪ Do not install Sikafloor® Level Pro over particleboard, hardwood floors, parquet floors or metal.
    - ▪ Do not mix or apply Sikafloor® Level Pro in temperatures below 10°C and above 35°C and under hot and windy conditions.
    - ▪ Keep product cool prior to mixing and do not leave bags in direct sun for extended periods.
    - ▪ Protect from hot or strong winds and extremes of temperature for 12hrs after being applied to avoid rapid moisture loss leading to cracking or crazing.
    - ▪ All construction/expansion joints in existing concrete must be reflected through Sikafloor® product as soon as possible to do so.
    - ▪ Not recommended as a trafficable surface.
    - ▪ Do not use on sloped surfaces that require drainage (wet areas).
    - ▪ Do not use in exterior applications.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. 10°C - 35°C
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.9):
    - ▪ Do not mix or apply Sikafloor® Level Pro in temperatures below 10°C and above 35°C and under hot and windy conditions.
    - ▪ Protect from hot or strong winds and extremes of temperature for 12hrs after being applied to avoid rapid moisture loss leading to cracking or crazing.
5.4 Basis of the stated values.
    - Manufactured in Australia.
    - All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor® Level PRO, March 2025, Version 02.07, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/sikafloor_level_pro.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor® Level PRO, version 01/02/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sds-sikafloor-levelpro.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall referto the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containingphysical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-re-lated data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
